# Action reference

`deps`: Update dependencies and open one pull request per dependency or group.

The composite action in the repository root downloads the released static `deps` binary for the runner, verifies it against the release's `checksums.txt` with `sha256sum`, prints `deps version`, and runs `deps <args>` with `DEPS_TOKEN` set to the `token` input. Go is not needed. The same `action.yml` works unchanged on GitHub Actions and on Gitea and Forgejo Actions.

The version is resolved first. With `cache: true` (the default) a binary of that version is reused instead of downloaded: from the runner's tool cache (`$RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE/deps/<version>/<arch>`, kept between jobs on self-hosted runners), else from the forge's Actions cache (`actions/cache/restore`, key `deps-<version>-linux-<arch>`; GitHub's cache service and the Gitea/Forgejo runner cache server). A cached binary runs only if its sha256 matches the checksum recorded from `checksums.txt` next to it; otherwise it is downloaded again. After a download the binary is saved to the Actions cache.

Only linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 runners are supported; on any other OS or architecture the first step fails with `deps: unsupported runner <os>/<arch>; only linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 are released`. Pin a release tag (`@v0.1.0`) so runs are reproducible; a ref that is not a release tag (`@main`) downloads the latest release.

Complete workflows, tokens and permissions are described in [Running deps in CI](../ci.md); the arguments in the [CLI reference](cli.md).

Runs as `composite` with the steps "Resolve deps version", "Check for a preinstalled deps", "Check tool cache", "Restore deps from the Actions cache", "Install deps", "Save deps to the Actions cache", "Run deps".

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `token` | no | `${{ github.token }}` | Platform token, exported to deps as DEPS_TOKEN. It needs contents:write and pull-requests:write (issues:write for the dependency dashboard). The default is the job token on GitHub, Gitea and Forgejo; on GitHub, PRs created with it do not trigger workflows and it cannot push changes to .github/workflows/*, so pass an App token or PAT (with workflows permission) here and to actions/checkout. |
| `signing-key` | no | none | Secret holding a passphrase-less private key (OpenSSH, or armored OpenPGP) that deps signs its commits with, exported as DEPS_SIGNING_KEY. The committer identity (config key gitAuthor, or DEPS_GIT_AUTHOR in the job env) must be the key owner's verified email on the forge for the signature to count as verified. Default: unsigned commits. |
| `args` | no | `run` | Arguments for deps, e.g. `run -v --log-level info` or `plan`. |
| `version` | no | none | Release tag to download, e.g. v0.1.0. Default: the action's ref when it is a release tag (`@v0.1.0`), else the latest release. When it equals the ref's version (`@<sha> # v0.1.0` with `version: v0.1.0`), deps updates it together with the ref. |
| `repository` | no | none | Repository URL the release is downloaded from. A Gitea/Forgejo URL finds the latest release via `<host>/api/v1/repos/<repo>/releases/latest`; a GitHub URL via api.github.com, and on github.com runners the assets are fetched with `gh release download` and the job token, so private repositories work. Default: https://github.com/jakobmoellerdev/deps on github.com runners, https://git.jakob-moeller.cloud/jakobmoellerdev/deps elsewhere. |
| `use-preinstalled` | no | `true` | Use a `deps` already on PATH (e.g. baked into the runner image) when `deps version` prints the resolved version; the cache and download steps are skipped then. The binary is trusted as is: it is not checked against the release's checksums.txt. `false` always uses the cache/download path. |
| `cache` | no | `true` | Reuse a verified binary of the same version instead of downloading it. The runner's tool cache (`$RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE/deps/<version>/<arch>`, kept between jobs on self-hosted runners) is checked first, then the forge's Actions cache (key `deps-<version>-<os>-<arch>`), which is filled after a download. A cached binary is used only if its sha256 matches the checksum recorded from the release's checksums.txt. `false` downloads every run. |

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `version` | The deps release that ran, e.g. v0.1.0. |
| `cache-hit` | `preinstalled` if a matching `deps` on PATH was used, `true` if the binary came from the tool cache or the Actions cache, `false` if it was downloaded. |

## Usage

### Gitea and Forgejo

Use the full URL: a short `jakobmoellerdev/deps@…` is resolved against the instance's `DEFAULT_ACTIONS_URL`, which is github.com by default.

```yaml
- uses: https://git.jakob-moeller.cloud/jakobmoellerdev/deps@vX.Y.Z
  with:
    # Platform token, exported to deps as DEPS_TOKEN.
    token: "${{ github.token }}"
    # Secret holding a passphrase-less private key (OpenSSH, or armored OpenPGP) that deps signs its commits with, exported as DEPS_SIGNING_KEY.
    signing-key: ""
    # Arguments for deps, e.g. `run -v --log-level info` or `plan`.
    args: run
    # Release tag to download, e.g. v0.1.0.
    version: ""
    # Repository URL the release is downloaded from.
    repository: ""
    # Use a `deps` already on PATH (e.g. baked into the runner image) when `deps version` prints the resolved version; the cache and download steps are skipped then.
    use-preinstalled: "true"
    # Reuse a verified binary of the same version instead of downloading it.
    cache: "true"
```

### GitHub

From the GitHub mirror; on github.com runners the binary is downloaded from the mirror's releases.

```yaml
- uses: jakobmoellerdev/deps@vX.Y.Z
  with:
    # Platform token, exported to deps as DEPS_TOKEN.
    token: "${{ github.token }}"
    # Secret holding a passphrase-less private key (OpenSSH, or armored OpenPGP) that deps signs its commits with, exported as DEPS_SIGNING_KEY.
    signing-key: ""
    # Arguments for deps, e.g. `run -v --log-level info` or `plan`.
    args: run
    # Release tag to download, e.g. v0.1.0.
    version: ""
    # Repository URL the release is downloaded from.
    repository: ""
    # Use a `deps` already on PATH (e.g. baked into the runner image) when `deps version` prints the resolved version; the cache and download steps are skipped then.
    use-preinstalled: "true"
    # Reuse a verified binary of the same version instead of downloading it.
    cache: "true"
```
